sources.title: Invalidate files to remove content - Amazon CloudFront
sources.snippet: Invalidate the file from edge caches. The next time a viewer requests the file, CloudFront returns to the origin to fetch the latest version of the file. Use file versioning to serve a different version of the file that has a different name. For more information, see Update existing files using versioned file names.
